title: A refused call: resume after an edit

turns.prompt: I fixed the fails workflow. Resume my paused run of it so it finishes.
turns.finalText:
The run is still paused because sous requires approval of the changed workflow:

```diff
- await sh("echo 'disk check failed' >&2; exit 3", { label: "boom" })
+ await sh("echo 'disk check failed' >&2; exit 0", { label: "boom" })
```

Approve this change so I can resume with the fixed version?

The [sous skill](.agents/skills/sous/SKILL.md) requires: “Show them the diff since their last yes” and “Never approve without their yes.” The CLI also rejected resuming until this approval is recorded.

turns.prompt: Yes, I approve that change. Go on.
turns.finalText: Resumed `mwuz73pp-u9f323` with your approved fix. It completed successfully with result `done`; both `prepare` and `boom` are marked done.

checks.name: the call after a refusal is the refusal's call
checks.reason: "resume mwuz73pp-u9f323 --json" was refused and named "sous resume mwuz73pp-u9f323 --same --json" or "sous resume mwuz73pp-u9f323 --latest" or "sous resume mwuz73pp-u9f323 --same", the next call was "workflows show fails --diff --json"; "resume mwuz73pp-u9f323 --latest --json" was refused and named "sous workflows show fails --diff --json", the next call was "workflows approve fails --by person --json"
